title: Order Picking Shift Leader (f/m/d)
description:
We have been the market leader in wholesale for 25 years, have more than 500 employees and more than 10 years of experience with multi-shift operations. Our order picking department needs a shift leader.

What you'll do
- Lead ten employees per shift
- Distribute orders and monitor deadlines
- Make sure safety rules are followed

What you bring
- Apprenticeship in warehouse logistics
- Experience in order picking
- Leadership experience desirable
